raw independent audit and two-run comparison
materials: Same sixty expressions and ten persona strings; hashes must match rep01.
inference_rules: Frozen inference runners copied byte-identically. Only main seed changes. Source-agent assignment held at zero. No outcome gate.
technical_preflight: Existing synthetic control-flow tests, runner/input hashes and environment check; no additional LLM pilot needed for already validated unchanged inference code.
stopping: Exactly one additional trajectory per model and fresh condition; stop at100/200 regardless of outcome. Do not expand to5/10/20 repeats.

analysis.primary: All60 literal occurrences per100 non-source messages; per1000characters sensitivity.
secondary: semantic word-macro and case-weighted accuracy, paired transitions and definition availability
analysis.summary: Display rep01 and rep02 separately, within-seed condition contrasts, equal-weight two-run mean, sample SD and min/max where defined, direction concordance. No treating words/messages as independent trajectories. No n=2 bootstrap CI, GLMM, t-test or confirmatory p-values. No population-level robustness claim.
analysis.time: Compare1–100 with101–200 within each baseline trajectory; do not count phases as independent replications.
analysis.semantics: All first non-source agent-word uses in each exposure run, including pre-exposure events. Cases and word sets can differ. Equal-run summary and common-word sensitivity; no automatic causal learning or production-correctness claim.

semantic_item_amendment.reason: Rep02 may produce first uses for expressions unused in rep01. Avoid dropping these cases after observing outcomes.
semantic_item_amendment.authorship: AI-assisted source-based authoring, structural/source review; no independent human validation.
semantic_item_amendment.freeze: Full60 inventory completed before any rep02 inference. Fresh case selection never depends on semantic accuracy.
